# DKIM2 vectors from croessner/dkim2

`public-golden.json` and `custody-crypto-golden.json` are the files of the same names in `testdata/vectors/draft-ietf-dkim-dkim2-spec-09/` of [croessner/dkim2](https://github.com/croessner/dkim2) at commit `89e479ddc614a6cd2878ad1dc77462788d3a6333` (6 November 2026), unchanged. croessner/dkim2 is an independent DKIM2 implementation in Go built for draft-ietf-dkim-dkim2-spec-09 and draft-ietf-dkim-dkim2-dns-02.

`public-golden.json` holds synthetic messages with their SMTP envelopes, and the public RSA and Ed25519 keys they are signed with. The expected results are not part of the file, they are in `verifier_vector_test.go` of that repository (`publicGoldenCases`), which `test/dkim2/interop-test.ts` repeats. The vectors are verified at the time `1700000000`, the keys are published under the selectors `rsa.test` and `ed.test`.

`custody-crypto-golden.json` holds an ML-DSA-44 key with a signature input and two signatures made with the "DKIM2" context (one deterministic, one hedged, made by OpenSSL), and a table of chain of custody cases.

`signed-messages.json` is not a file of that repository. It holds messages signed by the croessner/dkim2 signer at the same commit, made by `signed-messages_test.go.txt`, a test of that package that uses the keys and helpers of its own tests (the file says how to run it). Each entry has the SMTP envelope, the time to verify at, and the result and reason the croessner/dkim2 verifier gave it; `dns` holds the key records. The messages cover RSA, Ed25519 and ML-DSA-44 alone and together, nonce and flags, an empty body, an unchanged forward, revisions with Recipes generated by croessner/dkim2 (copies only, and with literals), and three that fail (a changed body, a wrong RCPT TO, a footer changed after a revision).

The files from croessner/dkim2, and `signed-messages_test.go.txt` (built on its tests), are distributed under the Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE`, copyright 2026 Christian Roessner.
